text.title: Text
text.description: Final agent text. Empty while the run is still running or on failure.

error.title: Error
error.description: Failure detail for failed/timed_out runs. Empty otherwise.

trajectory.title: Trajectory
trajectory.description: AgentEffect-shaped step dicts (kind, seq, content, tool_name, ...) — the adapter's normalize() over the framework's NATIVE output. Untyped passthrough in v1: the AgentEffect projection is a server-private shape still converging across frameworks; typing it here now would freeze a premature wire contract. A typed discriminated union lands in a follow-up.

cached_tokens.title: Cached Tokens
cached_tokens.description: Cache-READ input tokens (billed at the provider's cache-hit rate).

cache_creation_tokens.title: Cache Creation Tokens
cache_creation_tokens.description: Cache-WRITE input tokens (Anthropic cache_creation_input_tokens; 0 on providers without it).
